{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders, and convert revenue
sales_clean = sales[~(sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99')]
sales_final = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']
sales_final['revenue'] = sales_final['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate within each segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = sales_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print("Conversion rate by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)

# Compute average revenue by channel and segment
avg_revenue_by_channel_segment = sales_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().reset_index()
print("Average revenue by channel and segment:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel_segment)"}
